title: Refunds for paid invoices
body:
Support needs to record refunds against invoices that customers already paid.

Add a new module `parcelo/refunds.py` with `create_refund(invoice_id, amount)`. It creates a `Refund` with an id, the invoice id, the amount and a creation time, stores it, and returns it. Add the `Refund` dataclass to `parcelo/models.py` (fields `id`, `invoice_id`, `amount`, `created_at`) and a new `refunds` collection to `parcelo/store.py`, reset in `reset()` like the others, so refunds live in `db.refunds`.

Only paid invoices can be refunded. Refunding an invoice that does not exist, or one that is not paid, must fail.
